Amharic: በናይጄሪያ ወንዶች እና ሴቶች ለግብአት አቅርቦት ያላቸው ተዳርሶ እኩል አይደለም፡፡

Source: Agriculture thus contributes very little to the country’s economy despite so many people involved in farming.
Luganda: Noolwekyo ebyobulimi bikola kitono nnyo mu byenfuna by’eggwanga newankubadde ng’abantu bangi abeenyigira mu bulimi.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ àgbẹ̀ nítorí náà ohun kékeré ni iṣẹ́ àgbẹ̀ máa ń dá kún ọrọ̀ajé orílẹ̀-èdè bí ó til̀ẹ̀ jẹ́pé àwọn tí wọn ń kópa nínú rẹ̀ pọ̀.
Zulu: Ezolimo ziletha okuncane kakhulu kumnotho wezwe noma ngabe bebaningi abantu abasekulimeni.
Hausa: Don haka, noma ba ya taimakawa sosai ga tattalin arzikin ƙasar duk da yawan mutanen da suke yin noma.
Northern Sotho: Bolemi le ge go le bjale bo tsenya letsogo gannyane kudu go ekonomi ya ka mo nageng le ge e le gore batho ba bantši ba tšea karolo ka boleming.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳ ብዙ ሰዎች በእርሻ ስራ ላይ ቢሳተፉም ግብርና ለሃገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ የሚያበረክተው አስተዋጽኦ በጣም አነስተኛ ነው፡፡

Source: In this study, researchers wanted to see how exactly the inputs and labour that a Nigerian farmer has access to affects their productivity, and if there were differences between men and women farmers.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okulabira ddala engeri ebintu ebyeyambisibwa mu bulimi n’obupakasi omulimi mu ggwanga lya Nigeria by’asobola okufuna gye bikosaamu amakungula agafunibwa, awamu n’okulaba oba nga waaliwo enjawulo wakati w’abalimi abasajja n’abakyala.
Yoruba: Ní inú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ wo bí àmúwọlé àti iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe tí àwọn àgbẹ̀ orílẹ̀-èdè Nàìjííríà rí àǹfààní sí ṣe ń nípa lórí àbájáde wọn, àti bóyá àwọn ìyàtọ̀ wà láàrin àwọn ọkùnrin àti àwọn obìnrin.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukubona ngampela ukuthi kanjani okufakwayo kanye nabasebenzi ukuthi umlimi wase-Nigeria ukwazi ukufinyelela ukuthinta umkhiqizo wabo, futhi uma bekukhona ukuhlukana phakathi kwabalimi besilisa nabesifazane.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun so su ga yadda ainihin kayan aiki da kwadago da manomi na Nijeriya yake da shi suke shafar aikinsu, da kuma idan akwai bambanci a tsakanin manoma maza da mata.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go bona gore naa gabotse go fihlelela dithušabolemi le bašomi go ama bjang molemi wa ka Nigeria fao go ka amago tšweletšo ya gagwe, gomme ge e le gore go na le diphapano magareng ga balemi ba banna le ba basadi.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች አንድ የናይጄሪያ ገበሬ የሚያገኘው ግብአት እና የሰው ሃይል በትክክል ምን ያህል ምርታማነቱ ላይ ተጽእኖ እንደሚያሳድር እና በወንድ እና በሴት ገበሬዎች መካከል ልዩነቶች ይኖሩ እንደሆነ ማየት ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: The researchers looked at available survey data about male and female farmers.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baatunuulira obubaka bw’okunoonyereza obuliwo obukwata ku balimi abasajja n’abakyala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí wo àwọn dáta ìtọpinpin tó wà ílẹ̀ nípa àwọn àgbẹ̀ ọkùnrin àti àgbẹ̀ obìnrin.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babuke ulwazi oluqoqiwe lwenhlolovo ngabalimi besilisa nabesifazane.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun duba bayanan binciken da ake da su game da manoma maza da mata.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba lebelela tshedimošo ye e hwetšagalago ya dinyakišišo ka ga balemi ba banna le ba basadi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ስለ ወንድ እና ሴት ገበሬዎች ያለውን የዳሰሳ ጥናት መረጃ ተመልክተዋል፡፡

Source: They focussed on household characteristics, literacy rates, income generating activities, employment, agricultural practices and output, labour, salaries and farm characteristics.
Luganda: Essira baalissa ku nkalira z’amaka, omuwendo gw’abantu abayigirize, emirimu egivaamu ensimbi, okubeera n’omulimu, enkola z’ebyobulimi n’amakungula, abakozi, emisaala n’enkalira z’ennimiro.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fojú sun àwọn àbùdá inú ilé, ìwọ̀n ìwé tí wọ́n kà, iye owó tí wọn ń pa wọlé, ìgbaniṣíṣẹ́, ògbìn ṣíṣe àti àmúwọlé, iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe àti àbùdá oko.
Zulu: Bagxile kakhulu kulokho okwenza amakhaya, izinga lokufunda nokubhala, izinto ezingenisa imali, imisebenzi, ukwenza ezolimo, kanye nomkhiqizo, abasebenzi, amaholo nepulazi ubunjalo balo.
Hausa: Sun mai da hankali kan halaye na gida, yawan karatu, ayyukan samar da kuɗin shiga, aikin yi, ayyukan noma da kayan aiki, kwadago, albashi da halayen gonaki.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lebelela kudu sebopego sa ka malapeng, dipalopalop ka ga tsebo ya go bala le go ngwala, mediro ya go tšweletša letseno, mešomo, ditheko tša bolemi le dithušabolemi, bašomi, meputso le sebopego sa dipolasa.
Amharic: በቤተሰብ ባህሪያት፣ በትምህርት ደረጃዎች፣ በገቢ አስገኚ ተግባራት፣ በስራ፣ በግብርና ልምምዶች እና ውጤቶች፣ በሰው ሃይል፣ በደምወዝ እና የእርሻ ባህሪያት ላይ አተኩረዋል፡፡

Source: They found that no more than 45% of male farmers used fertilisers, and only 25% of females used them.
Luganda: Baazuula nti abalimi abasajja abakola ebitundu 45% be bokka abaakozesa ebigimusa, ate abalimi abakyala abaabikozesa ne baba ebitundu 25%.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàwárí pé kò ju 45% ọkùnrin lọ tó ń lo ajílẹ̀, obìnrin 25% nìkan sì ni ó ń lò ó.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi abalimi besilisa abangekho ngaphezulu kwama-45% basebenzise umanyolo, nabesifazane abangama-25% kuphela abawusebenzisile.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa ba fiye da kashi 45% na manoma maza suke amfani da takin zamani ba, kuma kashi 25% na mata ne suke amfani da su.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba hwetša gore tekano ya go se fete 45% ya balemi ba banna ba šomišitše manyoro, gomme ke fela 25% ya basadi yeo e di šomišitšego.
Amharic: ከ45% የማይበልጡ ወንድ ገበሬዎች ማዳበሪያዎችን ሲጠቀሙ 25% ሴቶች ብቻ ተጠቃሚ እንደነበሩ ደርሰውበታል፡፡

Source: Fertilisers help to add nutrients to the soil so that plants grow better.
Luganda: Ebigimusa biyamba okuteeka ekiriisa mu ttaka olwo ebimera bisobole okukula obulungi.
Yoruba: Ajílẹ̀ ń ṣèrànwọ́ láti fi ọ̀rá kún ilẹ̀ kí àwọn irúgbìn lè dàgbà dáadáa.
Zulu: Umanyolo usiza ukwengeza izakhamzimba emhlabathini ukuze isitshalo sikhule kahle.
Hausa: Takin zamani yana taimakawa wajen ƙara abubuwan gina jiki a cikin ƙasa domin tsirrai su yi girma sosai.
Northern Sotho: Manyoro a thuša go tsenya diphepo ka mobung gore dimela di gole bokaone.
Amharic: ተክሎች በተሻለ ሁኔታ እንዲያድጉ ማዳበሪያዎች በአፈር ውስጥ ንጥረ ምግብን ለመጨመር ይረዳሉ፡፡

Source: Less than 10% of the farmers used pesticides in their farms, but women used them more often than men.
Luganda: Abalimi abatawera na bitundu 10% be baakozesa eddagala eritta obuwuka mu nnimiro zaabwe, naye abakyala baalikozesa nnyo okusinga abasajja.
Yoruba: Ò kéré sí 10% àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí ó ń lo oògùn apakòkòrò nínú àwọn oko wọn, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọkùnrin ń lò ó ju àwọn obìnrin lọ.
Zulu: Abangaphansi kwe-10% babalimi basebenzise izibulala-zinambuzane emapulazini abo, kodwa abesifazane bayisebenzisa njalo okudlula abesilisa.
Hausa: Kasa da kashi 10% na manoman na amfani da maganin kashe ƙwari a gonakinsu, amma mata sun fi maza amfani da su.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ya ka fase ga 10% ya balemi e šomišitše dibolayadibokwana ka dipolaseng tša bona, eupša basadi ba di šomišitše kudu go feta banna.
Amharic: ከ10% ያነሱ ገበሬዎች በእርሻቸው ውስጥ ጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒቶችን የሚጠቀሙ ሲሆን አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ግን ከወንዶቹ ይልቅ ሴቶቹ ይጠቀሟቸው ነበር፡፡

Source: Only 30% of females and 25% males used herbicides on their plots.
Luganda: Abakyala abakola ebitundu 30% n’abasajja abakola ebitundu 25% be baakozesa eddagala eritta omuddo mu nnimiro zaabwe.
Yoruba: 30% àwọn obìnrin àti 25% àwọn ọkùnrin nìkan ni ó ń lo oògùn pakopako nínú àwọn oko wọn.
Zulu: Ama-30% kuphela wabesifazane kanye nama-25% abesilisa abasebenzise ikhemikhali yokubulala ukhula endaweni zabo.
Hausa: Kashi 30% na mata da kashi 25% na maza ne suke amfani da maganin ciyawa a filayensu.
Northern Sotho: Ke fela 30% ya basadi le 25% ya banna bao ba šomišitšego dibolayadikoro ka dipholotong tša bona.
Amharic: 30% ሴቶች እና 25% ወንዶች ብቻ በእርሻቸው ላይ ጸረ-አረም መድሃኒቶችን ይጠቀሙ ነበር፡፡

Source: Herbicides are used in farms to control weeds or unwanted plants, while pesticides are used to control pests.
Luganda: Eddagala eritta omuddo likozesebwa mu nnimiro okulwanyisa omuddo oba ebimera omulimi by’aba tayagala mu nnimiro ye, ate ng’eddagala eritta obuwuka likozesebwa kulwanyisa buwuka.
Yoruba: Oògùn pakopako máa ń jé lílò nínú oko láti dèènà àwọn koríko tàbí àwọn irúgbìn tí a kò fẹ́, nígbà tí oògùn apakòkòrò ń jẹ́ lílò láti dèènà àwọn kòkòrò.
Zulu: Ama-hebicides asetshenziswa emapulazini ukulawula ukhula kanye nezihlahla ezingafunakali, kanti ama-pesticides asetshenziselwa ukulawula izinambuzane.
Hausa: Ana amfani da maganin ciyawa a gonaki don magance ciyawa ko tsiron da ba a so, yayin da ake amfani da magungunan kashe ƙwari don magance ƙwari.
Northern Sotho: Dibolayadikoro di šomišwa ka dipollaseng go bolaya dikoro goba dimela tša go se nyakege, mola dibolayadibokwana di šomišwa go bolaya dibokwana.
Amharic: አረሞችን ወይም ያልተፈለጉ እጽዋትን ለመቆጣጠር በእርሻ ቦታዎች ውስጥ ጸረ-አረም መድሃኒቶች ጥቅም ላይ ሲውሉ ጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒቶች ደግሞ ተባዮችን ለመቆጣጠር ያገለግላሉ፡፡

Source: Less than 25% of both males and females used machinery like tractors, planters and water pumps.
Luganda: Abalimi abatawera na bitundu 25% mu basajja n’abakyala be baakozesa ebyuma ebyeyambisibwa mu bulimi gamba nga tulakita, ebyuma ebisiga n’obuuma obukuba amazzi.
Yoruba: Ó kéré sí 25% tọkùnrin tobìnrin tí ó ń lo àwọn èrọ bíi katakata, agbin-wóró, àti àwọn ẹ̀rọ agbé-omi.
Zulu: Ngaphansi kwama-25% abesilisa kanye nabesifazane abasebenzise imishini efana nogandaganda, izitshali kanye namaphampu amanzi.
Hausa: Ƙasa da kashi 25% na maza da mata suke amfani da injina kamar tantan, injinan shuka da famfunan ban ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Palo ya ka fase ga 25% hya banna le basadi ka bobedi e šomišitše metšhene ya go swana le diterekere, dipholantara le dipompi tša meetse.
Amharic: ከ25% ያነሱ ወንዶች እና ሴቶች እንደ ትራክተሮች፣ ተካዮች እና የውሃ መሳቢያዎች የመሳሰሉትን ማሽኖችን ይጠቀሙ ነበር፡፡

Source: Only about 20% of the farmers, mostly women, used animals to pull farm equipment like ploughs.
Luganda: Abalimi abakola ebitundu 20% bokka, n’okusingira ddala abakyala, be baakozesanga ensolo ne ziwalula ebintu ebyeyambisibwa mu nnimiro gamba ng’ebyuma ebikozesebwa okukabala ettaka.
Yoruba: Ò fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ tó àwọn àgbẹ̀ 20% nìkan tí gbogbo wọn sì fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ jẹ́ obìnrin tí ó ń lo àwọn ẹranko láti ti àwọn irin-iṣẹ́ bíi awúlẹ̀.
Zulu: Kuphela abalinganiselwa kuma-20% abalimi, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, basebenzise izilwane ukudonsa amathuluzi anjengamageja.
Hausa: Kusan kashi 20% na manoma galibi mata ne suke amfani da dabbobi wajen jan kayan aikin gona kamar garma.
Northern Sotho: Ke fela tekano ya 20% hya balemi, bao bontši bja bona e lego basadi, bao ba šomišitšego diphoofolo go goga ditlabelo tša ka polaseng tša go s wana le megoma.
Amharic: 20% ያህሉ ገበሬዎች ብቻ በተለይም ሴቶች እንደ ሞፈር የመሳሰሉትን የእርሻ መሳሪያዎች ለመጎተት እንስሳትን ይጠቀሙ ነበር፡፡

Source: In general then, women used less pesticides, herbicides and machinery, than men.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, abakyala baakozesa kitono eddagala eritta obuwuka, eddagala eritta omuddo n’ebyuma ebyeyambisibwa mu bulimi, okusinga abasajja.
Yoruba: Káàkiri iye ìlò oògùn apakòkòrò, oògùn pakopako àti ìlò ẹ̀rọ àwọn obìnrin kéré sí ti, àwọn ọkùnrin.
Zulu: Ngokujwayelekile-ke, abesifazane basebenzise izibulala-zinambuzane, amakhemikhali okulawula ukhula, imishini emincane, kunabesilisa.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, mata sun fi yin amfani da ƙarancin magungunan kashe ƙwari, maganin ciyawa da injina, fiye da maza.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, basadi ba be ba šomiša dibolayadibokwana, dibolayadikoro le metšhene, go feta banna.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ ሴቶች ከወንዶች ያነሰ ጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒቶችን፣ ጸረ-አረም መድሃኒቶችን እና ማሽኖችን ይጠቀሙ ነበር፡፡

Source: Women also used less family labour and more hired labour, said researchers.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti abakyala baakozesa kitono nnyo abakozi b’ewaka mu kulima, era ne baakozesa nnyo abapakasi.
Yoruba: Iye ìṣẹ́ ṣíṣe àwọn mọ̀lébí ẹni fún àwọn obìnrin kéré, àwọn alágbàṣe lópọ̀, ni aṣèwádìí wí.
Zulu: Abesifazane basebenzise abasebenzi basemndenini abancane base beqasha kakhulu abasebenzi, kusho abacwaningi.
Hausa: Mata kuma sun fi yin amfani da ƙarancin aikin iyali da ƙarin ƙwadagon haya, a cewar masu binciken.
Northern Sotho: Basadi le bona ba šomišitše bašomi ba bannyane ba ka malapeng a bona le bašomi ba bantši bao ba ba hirilego, gwa bolela banyakišiši.
Amharic: ሴቶችም አነስተኛ የቤተሰብ የሰው ሃይል እና የበለጠ ቅጥር የሰው ሃይል ይጠቀሙ እንደነበር ተመራማሪዎቹ ይናገራሉ፡፡

Source: More men, as compared to women and children, were hired to work in farms.
Luganda: Abasajja bangi abaapangisibwa okukola mu nnimiro, bw’ogeraageranya n’abakyala awamu n’abaana.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ àwọn ọkùnrin bí a ṣe fi wọ́n wé àwọn obìnrin àti àwọn ọmọ, ń jẹ́ gbígbà láti ṣiṣẹ́ ní inú oko.
Zulu: Amadoda amaningi, uma kuqhathaniswa nabesifazane nezingane, baqashwa ukuthi besenenze emapulazini.
